reviewDecisions.rationale: Realized prices/revenue and mature-memory supply constraints are economically material, but one specialist origin and obvious narrative saturation require independent company confirmation and the new v0.7 reset test.
Two independent first-party suppliers report acceleration beyond prior strong baselines; deep research must look for a fresh A-share company reset rather than generic theme exposure.
Full order books/high utilization are material, but cost inflation and weak EV demand make the winner ambiguous; this is a good margin-vs-volume deep-research case.
Specialist demand evidence plus official input-price acceleration create a falsifiable pass-through/mix thesis; deep research must prove margin capture.
Broad producer inflation identifies pressure but no narrow beneficiary or margin transmission.
Useful contradiction/context, but broad demand softness does not define a specific selection edge.
Strategic policy response lacks a frozen realized price/volume/company earnings bridge.
The event reverses the prior spot-rate thesis and should retire, not promote, stale shipping exposure.
